question: Which of the following states has the lowest literacy rate as per Census of India 2011?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Bihar**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Bihar** has the lowest literacy rate among the states of India as per the Census of India 2011.
 
• The literacy rate in Bihar as per the 2011 Census is approximately **63.82%**.
 
• In contrast, states like Tamil Nadu have significantly higher literacy rates, emphasizing the regional disparities in educational attainment.
 
• Efforts are being made to improve the educational infrastructure and literacy rate in Bihar through various government schemes and initiatives.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The **Census of India** is conducted every ten years by the Office of the Registrar General and Census Commissioner, under the Ministry of Home Affairs, Government of India.
 
• The 2011 Census was the 15th National Census of the country since 1872 and the 7th Census after independence.
 
• The Census provides comprehensive data on various demographic, social, and economic parameters, including literacy rates, which are crucial for policy-making and planning.
 
• Literacy is defined as the ability to read and write with understanding in any language for individuals aged seven years and above.
 
• Improving literacy rates is a key focus area for sustainable development and enhancing the overall human development index (HDI) of the country.
